# `Q-3-51` — CodeBlock Not Supported in ANSI Format

> CodeBlock elements cannot be rendered in ANSI terminal output.

## What this means

A code block is a fenced or indented region of pre-formatted
text, typically used for source code. The ANSI writer (used
when rendering to a terminal) does not yet support code blocks
and emits the error rather than rendering an unstyled block.

The omission is intentional: faithful ANSI rendering of a code
block needs syntax-highlighting integration that the writer
does not yet have.

## Why this happens

Your document contains a fenced or indented code block and you
rendered to ANSI output.

## How to fix

Render to a different output format if you need the code blocks
visible. HTML output uses a syntax highlighter; markdown output
preserves the fences for downstream tooling to highlight.

## Related

- `Q-3-50`, `Q-3-52`, `Q-3-53`, `Q-3-54`, `Q-3-55` — other
  block types the ANSI writer does not yet support.
